title: A Orchard for the Garden
author: Jude Yarrow
blurb: Freya Sterling, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
